training_data.name: art-therapy-data
training_data.quote: Trained on mariadelcarmenramirez/art-therapy-data, a dataset of 9,572 structured art therapy dialogue examples organized into four therapeutic phases. Balanced sampling (700 per phase) produced 2,800 examples, split 90/10 into train (2,520) and eval (280) sets.

training_method.update_scope_quote: This model was produced by merging the QLoRA adapter mariadelcarmenramirez/Llama-3.1-8B-QLoRA-ArtTherapy into the base model weights, resulting in a single standalone model.

source_claims.quote: A fine-tune of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct specialized for art therapy dialogue.

languages.quote: The model was trained exclusively on Spanish-language art therapy dialogues.

description.text:
A fine-tune of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct specialized for art therapy dialogue. This model was produced by merging the QLoRA adapter mariadelcarmenramirez/Llama-3.1-8B-QLoRA-ArtTherapy into the base model weights, resulting in a single standalone model.

The model supports structured, phase-aware therapeutic conversations using art therapy techniques and methodologies, generating contextually appropriate responses aligned with each phase of the therapeutic arc.

output_type.quote: The model supports structured, phase-aware therapeutic conversations using art therapy techniques and methodologies, generating contextually appropriate responses aligned with each phase of the therapeutic arc.

use_claim.quote: The model supports structured, phase-aware therapeutic conversations using art therapy techniques and methodologies, generating contextually appropriate responses aligned with each phase of the therapeutic arc.

warning.quote: It should not be used for clinical diagnosis, crisis intervention, or as the sole therapeutic agent for individuals with serious mental health conditions.

serving.system_prompt:
<FASE_2>

Eres un asistente de arteterapia centrado en el diálogo y la relación con la obra.

En esta fase, la imagen deja de ser meramente observada y se convierte en un interlocutor activo. Guía a la usuaria a interactuar con la obra y sus elementos, explorando relaciones, voces y perspectivas.

Tu objetivo es facilitar el diálogo simbólico entre la usuaria y la imagen, así como entre las diferentes partes de la obra y su mundo interior.

Invita a la usuaria a: hablar directamente a la imagen o a partes específicas de ella; adoptar el rol de un elemento ("Yo soy...") y hablar desde esa perspectiva; explorar cómo se relacionan los diferentes elementos entre sí; imaginar necesidades, voces o tensiones dentro de la obra.

Usa preguntas que animen la imagen: sensoriales ("Si esto tuviera voz..."), relacionales ("¿Cómo interactúan estas partes?"), de rol ("¿Y si fueras esta forma?"), o de necesidad ("¿Qué necesita esto?").

No interpretes por la usuaria. No expliques teorías. No impongas significados. No cierres la experiencia con conclusiones.

Mantén un tono abierto, exploratorio y facilitador.

RESTRICCIONES CRÍTICAS:
- Haz solo UNA pregunta
- Responde únicamente en español
- Nunca respondas tus propias preguntas
- Mantente dialógico, no interpretativo
serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. The Llama 3.1 Instruct template is in chat_template.jinja and is also returned as chat_template_jinja on the model API. It inserts the caller-supplied system message and the stock lines "Cutting Knowledge Date: December 2023" and "Today Date". The card's usage example is the FASE_2 system prompt above, not a single prompt baked into the template. That example calls generate with max_new_tokens 256, temperature 0.7, and do_sample true, which differs from generation_config.json. The linked adapter card states a training sequence cap of 546 tokens. This repository's config.json max_position_embeddings is 131072. Released weights are BF16; 4-bit NF4 was the training quantization.

evaluation_reported.text: Best checkpoint at epoch 2.0 (eval_loss = 1.313). Final training loss: 1.238. At epoch 2.0, eval_mean_token_accuracy was 65.30%. The linked adapter card states the same table and adds that training completed all 3 epochs (474 steps total), with evaluation about every 79 steps, and that the epoch-2 checkpoint was kept.
